summary: Iteration 10 (Faz 9) testing of NexusHesap. BACKEND — new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py, 28/32 passed: all 7 report kinds (sales/purchases/aging/stock/cashflow/vat/profit) return 200 with rows+totals and the arithmetic checks hold (sales totals gross/net == sum of rows for group=contact|product|month, group=month keys match YYYY-MM, aging buckets not_due+d1_30+d31_60+d61_90+d90p == row total for every row and totals split into totals_payable, stock cost_value/sale_value == sum of rows and cost_value == qty*cost per row, cashflow totals expose cash_now/expected_in/expected_out/projected with projected == cash_now+in-out, vat payable_vat == sales_vat-purchase_vat per row and in totals, profit margin == profit/revenue*100), unknown kind -> 404, no Mongo _id leak in any report row. Cargo catalog returns exactly 14 providers with navlungo/geliver/kolaykargo/basitkargo as kind=marketplace + installed flag; POST with api_key -> status connected (key masked ••••••••), POST without key -> not_configured with 'SİMÜLE' message, duplicate -> 400, unknown code -> 400, DELETE removes (catalog installed flips back to false), DELETE unknown -> 404. Work-order performance returns {operators,stations,total_done,date_from,date_to}; scrap_rate matches scrap/(produced+scrap), total_done == sum(operators.done); today's finished step (Ahmet Yılmaz / Montaj Hattı 1) shows up. B2B: POST /contacts/cnt_01/b2b-access returns link /portal/<token> with discount 5, unknown contact -> 404, GET /public/b2b/<token> returns contact (no ids/vkn), company, products priced at list_price*0.95, orders, invoices, installments; invalid token -> 404; disable -> GET+POST 404, re-enable -> 200. FAILURES: POST /public/b2b/<token>/orders returns 500 (Pydantic: Order.order_number missing) so B2B order creation, the resulting order in /api/orders and the b2b_order notification could not be produced; GET /api/integrations/cargo does not list providers added via POST (different Mongo collection). FRONTEND (Playwright, preview URL) — /reports: all 7 report-tab-* switch and load, report-preset-year sets 2026-01-01..today, report-group-contact|product|month all re-query correctly, KPI cards render (4, cashflow 7), report-table shows rows with a TOPLAM tfoot, report-export-excel triggers a real CSV download (sales-raporu-2026-01-01_2026-09-04.csv), report-export-pdf calls window.print; group buttons correctly hidden for aging/stock/cashflow/vat; no console errors. /portal/<token>: public page with no sidebar, header shows company + contact name + balance + 'Size özel %5 indirim', 4 products with 5% discounted prices (1.899 -> 1.804,05), b2b-search filters, b2b-add/inc/dec update b2b-cart and b2b-cart-total incl. KDV (2.164,86 -> 4.329,72 -> 2.164,86), cart persists across reload (localStorage), statement tab lists 15 invoices + balance, installments tab lists 7 pending with overdue highlighting, invalid token shows b2b-error; b2b-submit-order FAILS with red toast 'Sipariş gönderilemedi.' (backend 500) so b2b-order-done banner / order in b2b-tab-orders could not be verified. /contacts?contact_id=cnt_01: detail-b2b-access-btn shows toast with the portal link and opens the portal in a new tab (verified popup URL). /cargo: cargo-catalog renders 14 provider cards + 4 existing carrier cards, clicking cargo-catalog-geliver opens cargo-add-form with cargo-cred-api_key, cargo-add-submit adds it (toast mentions SİMÜLE) and the card becomes '✓ Ekli' and disabled — but the added marketplace never appears in the existing-carrier section (collection mismatch). /orders: orders-select-all selects 11, orders-bulk-bar shows the 4 buttons, bulk-labels-btn opens bulk-labels-modal with exactly 11 labels and bulk-labels-print calls window.print, bulk-clear-btn clears; on a freshly created pending order bulk-approve-btn -> '1 sipariş işlendi. Onay pazaryeri entegrasyonuna iletildi (SİMÜLE).' and bulk-invoice-btn -> '1 sipariş işlendi.' with the row turning Faturalandı. /atolye: shopfloor-performance panel with shopfloor-perf-toggle expands operator + station tables with perf-row-Ahmet Yılmaz / perf-row-Montaj Hattı 1 (1 adım, 2 üretim, %0 fire, 0.4 dk). All test data cleaned up.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error for every request. server.py:781 constructs Order(...) without order_number, but models.py Order requires order_number: str (it is only assigned on the dict after to_mongo). pydantic_core ValidationError: 'order_number Field required'. Entire B2B ordering flow (order creation, B2B-* numbering, contact_id/channel, portal order list, b2b_order notification) is dead, and the portal UI shows 'Sipariş gönderilemedi.'. Fix: pass order_number into the Order(...) call (compute the B2B-YYYY-NNNN sequence first) or make Order.order_number Optional like POST /api/orders assumes.

Collection mismatch: GET (server.py:3115) and PUT (3120) read/write db.cargo_configs while POST (3061) and DELETE (3080) use db.cargo_integrations. Providers added from the new catalog are therefore never returned by the list endpoint, are not shown in the /cargo 'existing carriers' section, cannot be configured (PUT) and can only be deleted if the caller already knows the generated _id. Unify on one collection.

minor.issue: Guard is `is_invoiced AND invoice_id`; 8 seeded orders (TR-66841873, TR-26334632, TR-26486877, TR-23770514, TR-28480792, TR-17008087, HB-10294820) have is_invoiced=true but invoice_id=null, so bulk/single invoicing will silently create a DUPLICATE invoice for them. Guard should be `is_invoiced OR invoice_id` (and backfill invoice_id).

Hardcoded contact_id 'cnt_01' and contact_tax_id '11111111111', vat_rate fixed at 20 and payment_status forced to 'paid' with paid_amount = grand_total. Invoices created from any non-cnt_01 order are attributed to the wrong cari and inflate the sales/aging/VAT reports.
Endpoint does not exist (404) — orders created by mistake or by tests cannot be removed via API; cleanup required direct Mongo access (see /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iteration10.py).

totals only aggregate rows with type=receivable (payables go to totals_payable) while rows contain both, so the UI TOPLAM footer does not equal the sum of the visible rows. Either split the table by type or label the footer 'Alacak Toplamı'.

ui_bugs.issue: Siparişi Gönder always fails with the red toast 'Sipariş gönderilemedi.' because of the backend 500; b2b-order-done banner and the new order in b2b-tab-orders are unreachable. Blocked on the backend fix.

Bulk invoice skip check uses only `o.invoice_id` (line 50) while the row badge uses is_invoiced — selecting an is_invoiced order without invoice_id sends it to convert-to-invoice and creates a duplicate invoice. Use `if (o.is_invoiced || o.invoice_id) continue;`.

When every selected order is skipped the user still gets a green success toast '0 sipariş işlendi. ' (trailing space). Should be an info/warning such as 'Seçili siparişlerin tümü zaten faturalanmış.'.

A single click on report-export-pdf and on bulk-labels-print invoked the stubbed window.print twice (counter = 2 in both flows). Likely a duplicated handler/listener — worth confirming, users may get two print dialogs.

integration_issues.issue: POST /public/b2b/<token>/orders 500 -> no order, no notification, portal order list stays empty

Provider added via cargo-add-submit shows '✓ Ekli' in the catalog but never appears in the existing-carrier card list, so there is no UI path to configure or remove it (GET /integrations/cargo reads another collection).

issues: Date range uses native <input type="date"> browser pickers instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere.
Aging tab TOPLAM footer only totals receivables while the table also lists payable rows (footer != visible rows).
Top bar still shows active company 'MATEK DEKORASYON' while every query uses comp_nexus_main_01 (pre-existing since iteration 6).
Customer-facing catalog exposes the dev test product 'deneme' (SKU ddd, 'Stokta yok', no image).
prod_01 (Kulaklık Pro Max) image renders as a plain solid red square — placeholder/broken asset shown to B2B customers.
Marketplace/catalog card sub-text on /cargo installed cards uses opacity-70 grey on white (low contrast).

action_items: CRITICAL: fix POST /api/public/b2b/{token}/orders 500 — supply order_number when constructing Order (server.py:781) or make Order.order_number Optional; then re-test the whole B2B order chain (order number B2B-*, contact_id, channel, appearance in /api/orders + portal, b2b_order notification).
HIGH: unify cargo collections — GET/PUT /api/integrations/cargo use db.cargo_configs while POST/DELETE use db.cargo_integrations; newly added marketplaces are invisible/unmanageable.

HIGH: change the invoiced guard to `is_invoiced || invoice_id` in both OrdersB2BPage.bulk() and convert_order_to_invoice, and backfill invoice_id on the 7-8 seeded orders to prevent duplicate invoices.
MEDIUM: convert-to-invoice must resolve the real contact (currently hardcodes cnt_01 / 11111111111 / vat 20 / payment_status paid).
MEDIUM: add DELETE /api/orders/{order_id} so erroneous/test orders can be removed.

LOW: aging report footer should be labelled/segmented (receivable vs payable); replace native date inputs with the shadcn calendar; show a warning instead of a success toast for '0 sipariş işlendi'; investigate the double window.print call; remove the 'deneme' test product / fix the red placeholder image from the B2B catalog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:781 b2b_create_order builds the Order model without the required order_number and then patches the dict — the model construction throws before the sequence is computed. Compute order_number first and pass it in; also wrap the endpoint so a Pydantic error cannot surface as a bare 500 to a public (unauthenticated) route.

server.py: two collections (cargo_configs / cargo_integrations) describe the same domain object and are accessed by different handlers of the same REST resource — a latent data-integrity bug beyond the listing symptom.
server.py:3212 convert_order_to_invoice idempotency check requires both is_invoiced and invoice_id; any legacy row with one of them set can be invoiced twice.
server.py:3240 invoice creation hardcodes contact_id/contact_tax_id and forces payment_status='paid' — this silently corrupts sales, aging, VAT and profit reports which all read db.invoices.
server.py is now 3773 lines; the report block (1476-1572) alone is ~100 dense lines with lambda-based rounding and would be far more testable as /routers/reports.py with per-kind functions.
GET /api/reports/{kind} loads up to 20000 invoices/products into memory and filters in Python for every request; push date_from/date_to and invoice_type into the Mongo query.
ReportsPage.jsx: report-kpi-* testids are derived from Turkish labels (e.g. report-kpi-Toplam Satış) — spaces in testids are brittle; use stable slugs.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% of requested flows (B2B order submission blocked by backend 500)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest tests/test_iteration10.py -p no:randomly -n 0` from /app/backend, then `python tests/cleanup_iteration10.py --purge-cargo` (the suite adds/removes cargo providers and creates a B2B order once the 500 is fixed; there is no DELETE /api/orders endpoint so cleanup is via Mongo). 4 known failures are the two real defects: test_create_order/test_order_visible_in_orders_and_portal/test_notification_created (B2B 500) and test_list_integrations_shows_added (cargo collection mismatch) — all other 28 assertions pass. Frontend testids verified: reports (report-tab-*, report-preset-year, report-from/to, report-group-*, report-kpi-<Turkish label>, report-table, report-row-N, report-export-excel/pdf), portal (b2b-portal, b2b-error, b2b-search, b2b-add-/inc-/dec-<sku>, b2b-cart, b2b-cart-total, b2b-note, b2b-submit-order, b2b-order-done, b2b-tab-catalog|orders|statement|installments), cargo (cargo-catalog, cargo-catalog-<code>, cargo-add-form, cargo-cred-<field>, cargo-add-submit, cargo-carrier-<code>), orders (orders-select-all, order-select-<order_number> — NOT order id, orders-bulk-bar, bulk-approve/invoice/labels/clear-btn, bulk-labels-modal, bulk-labels-print), atolye (shopfloor-performance, shopfloor-perf-toggle, perf-row-<name>). Iteration-9 'Taksitler (0)' stale badge is now fixed (shows (7) before opening the tab).
rca_of_the_issue: B2B order 500: models.Order declares `order_number: str` as required, but server.py:781 instantiates Order(...) with only company_id/channel/customer/items/total and assigns doc['order_number'] = B2B-YYYY-NNNN after to_mongo(); Pydantic raises ValidationError during construction, FastAPI converts it to 500 (traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). POST /api/orders avoids this because callers already send order_number (or it is generated before validation from an Optional-treated field). Cargo listing: POST/DELETE /api/integrations/cargo persist into db.cargo_integrations (also read by /integrations/cargo/catalog for the installed flag) whereas GET/PUT /api/integrations/cargo query db.cargo_configs, which only contains the 4 seeded carriers — hence 'installed ✓' in the catalog but absent from the manageable carrier list.
